resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says a wooden tower with a garage; the 1950 district report quoted by Forest Lookouts says aluminum. Both are reported in the story; not resolved.

firelookout.com says full-time staffing from 2012 and emergency status again by 2017; Cheryl Hill listed it as staffed in June 2016; Forest Lookouts says not staffed in the 2017 fire season. The sources agree on the sequence, but none gives the date staffing stopped.

notes_for_editor: Access level left unset: none of the four sources says whether the public may enter the tower, and the Register ties the site to an engine on high fire days. Total height not recorded: Forest Lookouts gives only the 20 ft ground-to-catwalk distance. The 1980s-to-2012 gap is undated in firelookout.com. The Roaming Civic and a Facebook group post describe the 1980s staffing history but were not read or cited. Register elevation 4,204 ft versus 4,200 ft elsewhere; not used in the story.
